name: stri_datetime_format
title: Date and Time Formatting and Parsing

origin.description: Formats a date-time object with an ICU pattern or a named style.
origin.usage: stri_datetime_format(time, format = "uuuu-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", tz = NULL, locale = NULL)

arguments.name: time
arguments.text: A POSIXct, or a character, Date, POSIXlt, or factor value coerced with as.POSIXct.

arguments.name: format
arguments.text: An ICU pattern, or a style such as date_full, time_medium, or datetime_relative_short.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default time zone, or one ICU time zone identifier.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default locale. A locale C is en_US_POSIX.

origin.details: A style is date, time, or datetime, optionally _relative, then _full, _long, _medium, or _short. A unique prefix of a whole style is a style. An ambiguous prefix is a pattern. A missing instant or a missing pattern stays missing.
origin.example:
x <- stri_datetime_format(stri_datetime_create(2015, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59, tz = "UTC"), "uuuu-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", tz = "UTC")
cat(paste0("stri_datetime_format of 2015-12-31 23:59:59 UTC is ", x, ".\n"))

translation.description: Formats instants with an ICU pattern or a named style.

arguments.name: time
arguments.text: Seconds since the epoch, a date-time string, NA, or a list of one kind.

arguments.name: format
arguments.text: An ICU pattern, or a style such as date_full, time_medium, or datetime_relative_short.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: None or "" for the default ICU zone, or one zone identifier.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: None or "" for the default locale. Surrounding spaces are removed. C is en_US_POSIX.

translation.details: Formatting uses ICU, not datetime.strftime. time_relative_* matches time_* because ICU ignores a relative time style. A missing instant or a missing pattern stays missing.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list or tuple returns a list.
translation.example:
from stringi.datetime import stri_datetime_create, stri_datetime_format
x = stri_datetime_format(stri_datetime_create(2015, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59, tz="UTC"), "uuuu-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", tz="UTC")
print(f"stri_datetime_format of 2015-12-31 23:59:59 UTC is {x}.")
